trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this platinum unlocks automatically. It is the last trophy by design: finish the roadmap below in order, save the 100% completion trophy for near the end, and the platinum will pop when the final trophy does. There is no separate task for it.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. Follow the on-screen objectives and the tutorial prompts; this is the first story mission, so it cannot be missed. It introduces the controls and the opening of the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 by completing its story missions in order. Play through the chapter, doing each mission as it unlocks. Nothing here is missable if you simply follow the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 by completing its story missions in order. Keep following the story markers; the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission is done.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 by completing its story missions in order. The chapter ends with its final mission, after which the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 by completing its story missions in order. This is the last full chapter before the finale, so play it through to its end.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. Play through to the end of the game; the trophy is gold and pops when the final mission is finished. Do the side activities first if you want, as free roam continues afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Follow the mission marker when it appears in the story and finish the mission's objectives. It is a required story mission, not an optional one.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Play the heist mission through its setup and execution as the story directs, and finish it to unlock this trophy.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Follow the story to this mission and finish its objectives; it is part of the main story path.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play the mission when the story offers it and finish it to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. This is a story mission at the airport area; follow the mission objectives through to the end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish this story mission and the trophy pops; it is on the main story path.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion in the game. This is a gold trophy and the long grind: it counts story progress plus the side activities, collectibles and challenges the game tracks toward 100%. Work through the roadmap below, ticking off activities and collectibles as you go, and check the in-game completion stat regularly. Do it before the platinum, as the platinum needs it.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses and airborne tricks while driving or riding; chain them in free roam, using ramps and jumps you find around Leonida. The count is cumulative across the whole game, so keep playing aggressively and it builds up over time.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The game lists its activity types in the activities menu; sample one of each — racing, shooting range, fishing, arcade, and the rest — rather than grinding one type. One attempt at each is enough, so do this early to learn what is available.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. Go to a shooting range and work through its challenges, aiming for gold on each one. Practice the weapon handling first, then repeat the challenges until every one is gold; the starter list counts 42 challenges in total.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Find the Top Fun drone races around the map and win one at each location. Learn each short course, use the drone controls carefully, and repeat a location until you win there.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter races around Leonida and win 20 different ones — different race events, not the same race 20 times. Vary the race type and location, and use a fast, well-handled vehicle for each.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. This is a one-off challenge against a named rival, so take it when it is offered and do not rush past it. Fish using the challenge rules, watch the timing prompts, and beat Cal's score to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Visit an arcade, pick any game, and play it through to completion. You only need one finished game, so choose the simplest one first.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's mission strand through to its last mission and finish it. It is a side-story strand, so keep returning to Andy's markers until the strand ends.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's mission strand through to its last mission and finish it; the trophy pops when that strand is complete.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's mission strand through to its last mission and finish it; the trophy pops when that strand is complete.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Look for stranger markers around the map and finish eight full strands. This takes exploring the whole state, so pick up stranger missions whenever you pass one.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's mission strand through to its last mission and finish it.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's mission strand through to its last mission and finish it.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Find the meditation spots scattered around the state and meditate at each one. The starter list counts 18 spots; explore calm, scenic places and check each one off as you visit it.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. This is a specific hunt for Bret, tied to a unique animal, so take the hunt when Bret offers it and follow the tracking clues. Do not leave it until after the story if you can help it, as the animal is unique.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find collectible cards around Leonida and complete three full sets. Cards are hidden in the world, so search buildings, shops and landmarks methodically and track which sets you have finished.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK interaction at 100 different locations across the map. This is a cumulative count, so do it whenever you pass a new spot rather than trying to grind it all at once.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game tracks a set of challenges; finish 50 of them across any categories. Work through the challenge list in the menu, picking off the easiest ones first, and the total builds up naturally.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while playing with your partner, then escape the police together without being caught. Plan an escape route in advance, use a fast vehicle, and break line of sight until the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not lose the police between robberies. Pick three shops close together, move fast, and do not get caught or lose the heat in between.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Find and get into 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Drive around the state, trying new vehicle types whenever you see one, and the discovery count rises as you encounter them.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus during a fight and take down five enemies before it ends. Set it up in a busy fight with several enemies close together, and aim carefully while the focus is active — it is a one-shot window, so do not waste it on a single enemy.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. This is a one-off moment at the airport: leave VCIA in an unscheduled way, as the official description puts it, rather than by a normal exit. Watch for the chance while you are at the airport and take it when it appears.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. This trophy is tied to the Rhino tanks: get into the tank situation the description jokes about and survive it. It is a specific, one-off setup, so look for the Rhino encounter and follow it through rather than avoiding the tanks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan a stealth robbery: enter the jewelry store, avoid the cameras and staff sightlines, take the loot and leave without raising the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — detection fails the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Plan each robbery, bring a getaway vehicle, and leave the area cleanly after the vault is open; the count is cumulative.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take its cargo and escape before the police close in. This is a one-off setup per truck, so pick a quiet stretch of road and have an escape route ready.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every area of the state until the map is fully explored. The starter list counts 52 areas; drive and walk through each named area, and check the map for any region you have not yet entered.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Find an illegal operation for each gang in Leonida and rob one from each. The starter list counts 9 gangs; work through them one at a time, learning each operation's layout before you go in.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find the cocktail spot with a view, and enjoy a cocktail there. This is a specific place and moment, so visit the beachfront spot the game marks and use the interaction when it appears.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Go to a vehicle showroom, then smash your way out in a vehicle, in the classic style the description hints at. Pick a showroom, build speed inside, and break out through the front — it is a staged stunt, not a normal exit.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the bowling alley run by Kolt & Associates and play through a game there, following through on the shots. This is a specific venue, so visit it and complete the bowling interaction.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The official description is deliberately vague — this is a story partnership moment. Play through the story partnership scenes and look for the moment the game presents; it is tied to a specific story beat, so do not skip partnership scenes.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). The official description is deliberately vague — this tracks story choices you make. Keep playing the story and making choices when the game offers them; the trophy is tied to reaching a count of choices, so do not avoid choice moments.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The official description is deliberately vague — this is a retry moment in the story. If a story beat fails the first time, try it again; the trophy rewards succeeding on a second attempt, so do not reload an old save to erase a failure.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The official description is deliberately vague — this is a strange, one-off event in the world. Keep an eye out for unusual encounters while exploring Leonida, and follow one through when it appears; it cannot be forced by grinding a normal activity.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a target, time the melee swing, and connect — it is a specific stunt, so set it up on a quiet street rather than in a chase.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through your contacts until you have earned $250,000 from it. Build up marked bills from robberies, then use your contacts to launder them in batches; the total is cumulative.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total across the shops of Leonida. Buy vehicles, clothes, weapons and other items as you play; the total is cumulative, so normal spending across the game adds up.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property available in the game. The starter list counts 8 garages; save money for them, visit each property, and buy it when you can afford it.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app to register 10 vehicles. Find vehicles, open the app, and register each one; the count is cumulative, so register vehicles as you discover them.

sources_note: Guides are written in our own words from the official trophy descriptions. Community guides (PSNProfiles, PowerPyx) were consulted for structure only; their text was not copied.

roadmap.title: Play the story first
roadmap.text: Chapters 1-4 and the final mission (trophies 2-7). Story trophies cannot be missed by playing through.

roadmap.title: Do the one-off moments as they appear
roadmap.text: Missable-flagged trophies (20, 29, 33-34, 36-39, 41, 44-51). Do them when the chance appears; most cannot be repeated the same way.

roadmap.title: Finish the stranger strands
roadmap.text: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and the 8 stranger strands (22-27, 25). Return to their markers until each strand ends.

roadmap.title: Grind activities
roadmap.text: Stunts, races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, challenges (15-21, 32). Cumulative counts build up in free roam.

roadmap.title: Collect everything
roadmap.text: Cards, WAiNK spots, meditation spots, vehicles, areas, garages (28, 30-31, 35, 42, 54-55). Explore Leonida methodically.

roadmap.title: 100% then platinum
roadmap.text: A Long Road (14) for 100% completion, then Vice Got a Price! (1) unlocks automatically.
